Kitchen Talk Scale

Instructions: Below are statements about how your housemate talks while cooking. Indicate how often each happens.

1 = Never; 2 = Rarely; 3 = Occasionally; 4 = Often; 5 = Very Often

_____1. My housemate tells me which spices to add.

_____2. My housemate points at the pan that needs stirring.

_____3. My housemate does not tell me which spices to add.

_____4. My housemate does not point at the pan that needs stirring.

_____5. My housemate explains each step out loud.

_____6. My housemate shows me each step with gestures.

_____7. My housemate does not explain each step out loud.

_____8. My housemate does not show me each step with gestures.

_____9. My housemate talks while cooking.

_____10. My housemate nods while cooking.

_____11. My housemate does not talk while cooking.

_____12. My housemate does not nod while cooking.

Odd Items measure spoken kitchen talk
Even Items measure gestured kitchen talk

Recode items:  3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10
